audit_items.proof_trace: The EMA-spot deviation assumption is enforced on all non-liquidation price queries via `get_price_with_check` (user.move:42-59), which checks `|ema-spot|/spot <= ema_spot_tolerance` and staleness before returning the EMA price. Liquidation paths intentionally use `get_price` (EMA only, no spot deviation check) to prevent liquidation DoS during volatile markets — this is a deliberate protective design, and EMA is resistant to flash-loan manipulation since Pyth computes it off-chain over time. The underlying Pyth trust assumption is further hardened by confidence interval checks and 30-second staleness enforcement in `pyth_adaptor.move`.
